import cProfile, io, pstats, tempfile, time
from commontrace import fact_store, hierarchical as h
from benchmarks import next_generation_storage as bench
root = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='commontrace-f1-profile-')
fact_store.migrate(root)
for start in range(0, 10_000, 1000):
    h.add_facts(root, bench.items(start, min(1000, 10_000 - start)))
batch = bench.items(10_010, 1000)
prof = cProfile.Profile()
started = time.perf_counter(); prof.enable(); result = h.add_facts(root, batch); prof.disable(); elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
print('exact_batch_elapsed_seconds', elapsed, 'facts_per_second', len(result)/elapsed)
stream = io.StringIO(); pstats.Stats(prof, stream=stream).strip_dirs().sort_stats('cumtime').print_stats(35)
print(stream.getvalue())
fact_store.close_connections(root)
commands.matched_30k_stdin_program:
import json, tempfile, time
from commontrace import fact_store, hierarchical as h
from benchmarks import next_generation_storage as bench
original = fact_store.StatementIndex.prime_near_blocks
rounds = []
try:
    for label, enabled in [('baseline-1', False), ('candidate-1', True), ('candidate-2', True), ('baseline-2', False)]:
        fact_store.StatementIndex.prime_near_blocks = original if enabled else (lambda self, statements: None)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='commontrace-f1-matched-30k-') as root:
            fact_store.migrate(root)
            started = time.perf_counter()
            for start in range(0, 30_000, 1000):
                h.add_facts(root, bench.items(start, min(1000, 30_000 - start)))
            seeded_seconds = time.perf_counter() - started
            measured = bench.measure(root, 30_000, 5)
            row = {'run': label, 'prefetch_enabled': enabled, 'seed_elapsed_seconds': seeded_seconds, **measured}
            rounds.append(row)
            print(label, json.dumps({k: row[k] for k in ('single_write_p50_ms','single_write_p95_ms','sparse_overlap_search_p50_ms','sparse_overlap_search_p95_ms','batch_facts_per_second','batch_elapsed_seconds','seed_elapsed_seconds')}), flush=True)
            fact_store.close_connections(root)
finally:
    fact_store.StatementIndex.prime_near_blocks = original
print('summary_json', json.dumps(rounds), flush=True)
